## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: An intervention record without a gap category from the vocabulary fails...

The system SHALL ensure that an intervention record without a gap category from the vocabulary fails validation.

#### Scenario: An intervention record without a gap category from the vocabulary fails...

WHEN `add-gap-taxonomy-and-ledger-links-to-intervention-records` is implemented
THEN An intervention record without a gap category from the vocabulary fails validation.

### Requirement: An intervention recorded during a debugging session stores a resolvable...

The system SHALL ensure that an intervention recorded during a debugging session stores a resolvable reference to that session's evidence ledger.

#### Scenario: An intervention recorded during a debugging session stores a resolvable...

WHEN `add-gap-taxonomy-and-ledger-links-to-intervention-records` is implemented
THEN An intervention recorded during a debugging session stores a resolvable reference to that session's evidence ledger.
